gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.00247 40.750406)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.00247 40.750406)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.858204 37.319739)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.858204 37.319739)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.00247, 40.750406), 4326)::geography AS geom

    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-121.858204, 37.319739), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    ST_Value(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, ST_SRID(r.rast))
    ) AS elevation
  FROM 
    points_of_interest p
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(
      ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, ST_SRID(r.rast)),
      r.rast
    )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT elevation FROM elevations WHERE id = '[3]') -
  (SELECT elevation FROM elevations WHERE id = '[4]') AS elevation_difference_meters;
